videos.lesson_topic: What is cloud computing, six advantages of cloud, CapEx vs OpEx, pay-as-you-go, elasticity
videos.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate 2020 (freeCodeCamp full course) — Introduction / Cloud Concepts sections
transcript_key_points: Cloud computing = on-demand IT resources over the internet, pay-as-you-go
Six advantages: trade CapEx for OpEx, economies of scale, stop guessing capacity, speed and agility, stop running data centers, go global in minutes

videos.credit: freeCodeCamp.org — same course as above. Used with attribution; not re-uploaded.
videos.lesson_topic: AWS Global Infrastructure: Regions, Availability Zones, edge locations
videos.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate 2020 (freeCodeCamp full course) — AWS Global Infrastructure section
transcript_key_points: Region = geographic area with multiple isolated AZs
AZ = discrete data centers with redundant power/networking
Edge locations cache content via CloudFront; not for running compute
Region choice: latency, compliance/data residency, service availability, cost

videos.credit: freeCodeCamp.org — same course as above. Used with attribution; not re-uploaded.
videos.lesson_topic: Shared Responsibility Model: security OF the cloud vs security IN the cloud
videos.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate 2020 (freeCodeCamp full course) — Shared Responsibility Model section
transcript_key_points: AWS: security OF the cloud (hardware, facilities, virtualization)
Customer: security IN the cloud (data, OS, IAM, firewall config)
Responsibility shifts with service model: IaaS vs PaaS vs SaaS

videos.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate 2020 (freeCodeCamp full course) — Cloud deployment and service models section
transcript_key_points: Public vs private vs hybrid deployment
IaaS (EC2) vs PaaS (Elastic Beanstalk) vs SaaS (WorkMail) — who manages what
